name: Mixer
description: Audio mixer/router — dynamic IAudioNode channels, multi-output routing
changelog: 0.16.1: a channel slot gets its block of scratch when a channel is registered in it, not at setup() for all sixteen: with the scratch in internal RAM (core 2.15.0 AlignedVector) six unused slots were 3 kB of it.

0.16.0: + renderOnly(): the channels asked for, pulled and panned as render() leaves them, nothing sent to an output -- for a render no one hears (a freeze faster than real time), which renderTap() then reads.
0.15.1: MIXPROF gives each node's longest pass after its average (nodes=ch:avg/max): a spike says which node made it.

0.15.0: the Mixer in the UX 2000 design, sized for a finger: five tabs -- IN (inputs: GAIN or PAN, MON to every output heard, a row per socket, PAIR where the board has more inputs than ADCs), SOURCES (LEVEL or PAN, M, S), OUT (the masters and every output with a level of its own: LEVEL, M, LIM lit while the limiter works), ROUTE (a chip per source and output, CLEAR, RESET) and PRESETS (the desk saved and loaded by name, UNDO) -- rows with a 152 px zone a finger drags and two keys, the rest of a channel (sends, monitor, pan, an output's tone) behind its name; the engine is the only state, so anything else that moves the mix shows up here.

0.14.5: defines CROSSPAD_USE_ESP_DSP for itself on esp32s3, which core 2.0 no longer exports; builds on core 1.70+/gui 1.28+ and on core/gui 2.x (>=1.70.0,<3.0.0 and >=1.28.0,<3.0.0) for the merge window; a root deleted before the app's teardown is handled (gui 2.0 calls destroy with none)

0.14.4: the reference pass is gone with core 1.66's kernel switch: an output the limiter leaves alone is never clamped. The render-kernels test holds the output to a digest recorded through the old loops.
0.14.3: MIXPROF formats its microseconds as integers: no double through snprintf on the board's 4 kB main task, where dtoa with an interrupt on top overflowed the stack.

0.14.2: render() through core 1.64's dsp kernels: a send is one madd.s pass (esp-dsp took two, through a scratch), channel and output peaks are branchless, the pan and the output fader one pass, the EQ both channels at once; on the S3 four floats a load where the buffers are on 16 bytes (channel scratch now is). An output the limiter leaves alone takes no clamp pass: its peaks are the limiter's. Same buses bit for bit wherever nothing fuses a multiply-add; on the S3 a send rounds once, not twice.
0.14.1: builds against an LVGL whose lv_part_t is an enum (the PC simulator's): the OUT bracket's gap reads LV_PART_MAIN, not 0.

0.14.0: main's 0.13.0 (OUT a row per speaker and jack at its hardware level, desk v5, input pairs, channels by name) with the engine branch's two since it: every output and the pads tap end in a per-block peak limiter with a hold, not a clamp at full scale -- its ceiling per output from the codec after it (setOutputCeiling), one block of lookahead on a bus that is only recorded (setOutputLookahead), MIX_LVL lim= the deepest gain since the last read -- and setChannelTrim(), a second gain beside a fader on the buses and the tap, never saved with the desk (Arrange puts a seq track's fader there while the song plays). The engine branch's OUT rows for the jacks are gone: the IOutputLevels rows are them.

0.13.0: OUT shows what a bus plays through where the board gives each its own level in the hardware (IOutputLevels, core 1.55.0): on CrossPad Speakers and Out 1/2 (one stream, held together by a bracket) and Out 3/4, each row's fader the codec's analog level after the DAC and its M a mute (the speakers' amp off). Such a bus plays at unity and is never muted in the engine (AudioMixerEngine::setOutputUnity): no fader in front of the DAC, no pass of multiplying, and a desk, a preset or MIX_OUT_VOL leave it there. render() skips the output gain at 1.0 everywhere

0.11.0: desk format 4 -- a saved channel is loaded onto the live channel of the same name wherever it now sits (the slot is only a hint), so a desk saved before the native sampler's Sampler2 channel (or with it, on a build without it) keeps USB, Click and the inputs on USB, Click and the inputs; earlier desks lost those channels' settings to the name guard. The desk's JSON moved to MixerState.cpp so a platform builds it -Os and the render -O2; tests/test_desk_migration.cpp

0.10.0: 0.8.1 (master: input pairs, silent channels skipped, NaN kept off the buses) and 0.9.1 (the engine branch: Source switch, IN as USB/Line/Mic, EQ across the outputs, per-channel render timing) merged; the look-up table files both the IN1/IN2/IN3 and the Line/Mic channel names

0.8.1 (0.7.2 merged in): render() neither pans nor sends a channel whose block is silent (peak 0) -- the buses come out bit for bit the same, and every quiet channel saves two passes per send; a block of only NaN and zeros no longer reaches the buses (renderTap() still sums it); host tests in tests/, the scalar and the esp-dsp path

0.8.0: the input pair on IN (IInputPairs, core 1.44.0): Mic + 1/2, Mic + 3/4, 1/2 + 3/4 where the board has three inputs on two ADCs; Line 1/2 and Line 3/4 as their own rows on IN and ROUTE, the input left out dimmed with its gain and sends kept
0.7.1: saveState()/loadState() through stdio instead of fstream (smaller firmware image); same file, same .tmp/.bak commit and fallback
0.9.1: saveState()/loadState() through stdio instead of fstream (smaller firmware image); same file, same .tmp/.bak commit and fallback

0.9.0: IN reads USB in, In 1/2, In 3/4, Mic. The two line sockets share one converter, so they are two rows over one channel: the one the converter is on is live, the other is dimmed, and tapping it makes it live. Also fixes the page they were filed under -- the look-up table still said IN1/IN2 after the platform renamed the channels Mic and Line, which quietly put both on SOURCES.

0.8.0: a Source switch in the channel window for an input whose board gives it a choice -- on CrossPad the two line-in jacks share one converter, so Line picks In 1/2 or In 3/4. Needs core 1.43 (IInputGain::sources/setSource).

0.7.0: AudioMixerEngine::renderTap() -- chosen channels as the mix has them (fader, pan, mute, solo) summed after render, whatever they are sent to: the platform records a bounce from the pads alone, not from a bus the inputs can reach

0.6.0: PRESETS (the list tab) -- the whole desk (levels, mutes, pan, sends, outputs, input gain) saved under a name on the card, loaded back, UNDO for the last load; STREAM, BEATS and SAMPLING start as a starting point for their name; MixerPresets, the platform names the folder

0.5.0 (0.4.1 merged in: builds on the PC against LVGL 9.4): MONITOR on every input (MON on its row, a Monitor row in its window): off, 1/2, 3/4 or both -- the outputs the engine marks heard; outputs named 1/2 (speakers) and 3/4 (phones); AudioMixerEngine::setOutputHeard/isOutputHeard
0.4.0: IN / SOURCES / OUT / ROUTE tabs along the bottom, a row per channel with a long fader, the channel window (input gain, pan, sends); requires core 1.25 (IInputGain) and gui 1.14
0.2.1: Merge lvgl.h include fix + PlatformIO library.json with MixerPadLogic registration
0.2.0: Dynamic IAudioNode-based channels (up to 16 × 8 outputs); ESP-IDF build target
0.1.0: Initial release — VU meters, 3x2 routing matrix, volume + mute/solo
